issuer_name: BNB Plus Corp. (formerly Applied DNA Sciences, Inc.)

website.error: Company is now a digital asset treasury (DAT) company; no proprietary clinical pipeline page maintained

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: BNB Plus Corp. is primarily a digital asset treasury (DAT) company focused on accumulating BNB cryptocurrency. Its 98%-owned subsidiary LineaRx, Inc. is a CDMO/services business commercializing the LineaDNA, LineaRNAP, and LineaIVT cell-free nucleic acid manufacturing platforms for third-party biotech customers; LineaRx does not own any proprietary drug or biologic in clinical development. The company's stated business strategy is to sell or license LineaRx to a third party. No active P1/P2/P3 trials with the company as sponsor.
